### Headline summary
- Anthropic is targeting a $1.4 trillion valuation in its upcoming IPO while releasing new models Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/09/anthropic-reportedly-plans-to-move-forward-with-ipo-plans/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261109/p48#a261109p48), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/09/anthropic-launches-fable-5-2-and-mythos-5-2-with-science-coding-upgrades/), [Prompt Engineering](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BsWS2dImirs))
- Nvidia's board has launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang, a move that has triggered an espionage probe and market losses. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/jensen-huang), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/video/2026/nov/09/trump-hegseth-jensen-huang))
- Google has made its Gemini 4 Carbon model widely available to the public and API users following a limited cybersecurity release. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2311855/gemini-4-carbon-now-available-worldwide/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1030787/google-gemini-4-carbon-public-rollout))

### Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion valuation in IPO
Anthropic has set a price range of $70 to $78 per share for its initial public offering, targeting a valuation of approximately $1.4 trillion. The company is seeking to raise up to $90 billion in the listing. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/09/anthropic-reportedly-plans-to-move-forward-with-ipo-plans/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261109/p48#a261109p48), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-10/anthropic-targets-64-4-billion-ipo-nearing-spacex-s-record), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/anthropic-sets-ipo-price-range-blockbuster-ipo-valuation-2026-11))

### Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang
Nvidia's board of directors has launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang, a development that has sparked an espionage investigation and resulted in market losses. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/jensen-huang), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/video/2026/nov/09/trump-hegseth-jensen-huang), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://gizmodo.com/trump-says-he-told-an-ai-executive-to-kiss-his-family-goodbye-before-going-to-jail-2000837040), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/jensen-huang-alice-huang-photos-slideshow-wechat-2026-11))

### Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
Anthropic released new AI models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, featuring upgrades in science, coding, and agent capabilities, with some reports noting the launch occurred ahead of an IPO. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/09/anthropic-launches-fable-5-2-and-mythos-5-2-with-science-coding-upgrades/), [Prompt Engineering](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BsWS2dImirs), [Simon Willison's Weblog](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/10/prompting-claude-fable-52/), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/machines/anthropic-launches-fable-5-2-and-mythos-5-2-ahead-of-ipo-ai-models))

### Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon
Google made its Gemini 4 Carbon model widely available to the public and paid API users, following a limited release to cybersecurity companies, and previewed a swarm feature. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2311855/gemini-4-carbon-now-available-worldwide/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1030787/google-gemini-4-carbon-public-rollout), [Sam Witteveen](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l32KKNKdpIk), [DeepMind Blog](https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-4-carbon-is-now-available/))

### Australia announces mandatory AI safety regulator
The Australian government announced the creation of a new AI safety regulator with the power to impose significant penalties and mandatory safeguards. This decision follows a recent security breach involving an OpenAI model. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/australia-releases-ai-safety-recommendations-after-openai-breach/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-10/australia-to-create-ai-safety-regulator-mandatory-safety-rules), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261109/p53#a261109p53), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://theconversation.com/new-ai-regulator-announced-as-government-considers-criminal-law-change-to-keep-erring-frontier-companies-in-line-296274))

### Mercor raises $750M Series D at $20B valuation
AI training startup Mercor announced a $750 million Series D round led by Benchmark, General Catalyst, and Nvidia. The funding values the company at $20 billion, doubling its valuation from October 2025. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/mercor-raises-750m-series-d-at-20b-valuation-to-expand-ai-training/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261110/p29#a261110p29))

### Meta releases Muse Ember AI model
Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Ember, described as its smallest and most efficient model designed for high-volume agent work. The model is intended to power cost-efficient AI agents. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/09/meta-introduces-muse-ember-to-power-cost-efficient-ai-agents/), [MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/09/meta-muse-ember-small-agent-model/), [Simon Willison's Weblog](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/10/muse-ember/))

### Adobe unveils AI agents and creative tools at Max
At the Adobe Max conference, Adobe announced new AI-powered tools and agents for Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly, including a prototype builder and generative video features. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2311901/adobe-firefly-ai-assistant-can-now-take-on-recurring-tasks-for-you/), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/10/adobe-expands-ai-assistant-into-creative-workflows/), [PetaPixel](https://petapixel.com/2026/11/10/premiere-update-brings-color-mode-out-of-beta-plus-generative-video-ai-audio-tools/), [PetaPixel](https://petapixel.com/2026/11/10/adobes-creative-agent-wants-to-do-the-photo-and-video-editing-tasks-you-dont-want-to/))
